Chapter 6676: Indomitable Dao Heart

Chapter 6676: Indomitable Dao Heart

“It doesn’t matter how you try to portray it, it is not true kindness, only a weapon.” Li Qiye shook his head.

“Sure, but it is the most beautiful weapon. Fellow Daoist, get ready.” Evil Transformation said.

“Come.” Li Qiye said.

“Buzz.” Evil Transformation took out a perfect heart from his body - one not made out of flesh but kindness.

This affinity spread across the battlefield and melted the primordial chaos into kindness. This meant Evil Transformation had total control of the battlefield.

“Buzz.” Some strands of kindness somehow surged out of the endless battlefield and reached Three Immortals.

They permeated across the realms and affected everyone, removing any suppression or external force threatening them.

This warmth melted their heart, causing them to fall to the ground and weep: “My sins... they’re unforgivable...”

This pure affinity of kindness left them in a state of atonement. Only overlords resisted the urge to kneel.

Just some remnant strands had this much power. The totality of this heart would immediately take over.

“Kindness can do this?” Overlords dodged the strands, not wanting to be melted by this affinity and become a part of the heart.

“Rather unique.” Primal Yin Immortal Ghost feared it.

This type of kindness was countless times more frightening than light and holiness since these affinities couldn’t disintegrate them.

In this case, Li Qiye was the sole focus, becoming engulfed by the ocean of kindness. He stood still without evading.

Others had no method to deal with it. Kindness was the weakest part of their existence and a flaw in their grand dao, leaving them exposed.

Once concentrated to the highest level, this flood could melt anyone as if they were a statue of mud thrown into the ocean. Thus, others imagined Li Qiye’s fate.

However, contrary to expectation, they heard loud heartbeats. The firm and mighty beats woke up everyone, preventing the melting process.

Something resonated in their heart, piercing through their soul and true fate.

“What is this power?!” All inhabitants found themselves more determined.

“Thump! Thump!” Overlords saw rays emanating from Li Qiye’s chest. They appeared indomitable, capable of pushing up worlds.

Suddenly, the vision of an indomitable dao heart appeared in their mind. They couldn’t see its shape; only those with a strong enough dao heart could truly see it.

Nothing could shake it, not a malevolent evil, eternal darkness, or extreme kindness. It stood strong like a mountain; gentle breezes couldn’t move it an inch. It was immune to the weathering of time and the elements - the only force that couldn’t be broken in this world.

“The dao heart.” Evil Transformation sighed and said: “It appears my pure kindness cannot change you.”

“I used my dao heart to block the heart of kindness to show respect to those who have given it up.” Li Qiye smiled and said.

“How embarrassing, I have displayed my slight skill before an expert.” Evil Transformation said.

Dao hearts with weakness were susceptible to openings for the kind affinity to infiltrate. This simply didn’t work on Li Qiye.

“My turn, Fellow Daoist.” Fiendish Ground approached with a surge of dignified and dreadful ghost intent.
